cell_kind: SAME-FLIGHT NODE COLUMN over the Solver reasoning budget and completion cap -- 2 arms (no twin) paired per row against the delivering budget-3072 arm; claim ceiling nominated
claim_boundary: No benefit, system-level, superiority, generalisation, held-out, confirmatory or paper-scale claim.

contacts.scorer: CPU official scorer jobs over derived copies only

declared_offset.basis: owner decision 313 A: the larger of the two measured same-core A/A offsets

stages.1_columns: bash scripts/flights/nx/nxt_r2b_read.sh columns  (stage3_rollout_score --mode perception-branches: one complete official scoring per arm; no number printed)
stages.smoke: python -B scripts/analysis/slurp_nxt_r2b_solver_budget_column_read.py --stage smoke (per-arm per-node decode cost; no countersignature; the machine sign-off input for the column flight)

what_is_not_here: No margins block and no admission: nothing is locked here.

word_rules.GAIN: SLU CI95 lower bound above +|o| (the raised Solver budget RAISES the score beyond the declared A/A width)
word_rules.HARM: SLU CI95 upper bound below -|o| (the raised budget loses more than the declared A/A width)
word_rules.NEEDS-NO-MORE-BUDGET: SLU CI95 upper bound <= +1.49 pp and intent CI95 upper bound <= +0.65 pp (decision 190 floors): any gain is inside the design's own resolution, so the raise buys no resolved gain and the delivering budget is enough
word_rules.UNRESOLVED: none of the above (the interval is too wide to call the raise a gain, a harm or no resolved gain)
